name: Render cloud platform homepage by render.com
description: A light, grid-disciplined cloud-infrastructure landing page that persuades with real product UI rather than decoration. The hero pairs an oversized grotesque headline with a mock deployment panel (service cards, sparklines, a '$ git push' mono chip) over faint grid lines. Below the hero the rhythm alternates between airy white sections and tinted full-bleed bands: a quiet monochrome logo wall, a numbered three-step flow illustrated with UI fragments, a saturated purple stack band, then a lavender bento grid where cards alternate text-plus-mockup layouts and switch chart colour from violet to green. It closes with sparse icon-led capability and security grids, a playful floating-tile CTA, and a dense black footer with a pixel motif. One violet accent, black rectangular CTAs, hairline borders, and mono type for terminal labels hold the whole page together.
